# evm-vanity

> Open-source EVM vanity wallet generator: grind a 0x address in your browser, delegate hard patterns with secp256k1 split-key grinding that cannot expose your key, and verify EIP-712 provenance attestations on chain.

evm-vanity is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.
